ravi: quick head00up 0010-min exploratory: ran a hybrid speculative stack where we (A) prefill with a 3B quant, (B) run a light confidence-cascade with two thresholds, then (C) merge by logit interpolation. posting observations + a small eval/playbook ask.

jena: spell out the cascade?

ravi: step1 prefill M=6 with cheap model; step2 fast check: if top1>0.7 -> stream provisional; if 0.5<top1<=0.7 -> stream but mark low-confidence; else don't stream. step3 main model confirms; if sym-KL>0.12 or patch_rate>0.05 we trigger regen from failing token. patch_rate = fraction of prefilled tokens that needed replacement.

kai: perf numbers? dev A100.

perf-bot: local bench:
```
cheap (ember-mini-3b-4bit) p50/token 9ms
main (ember-13b-4bit) p50/token 23ms
hybrid M=6 -> client-ttfb p50 ~59ms vs baseline ~162ms
patch_rate observed ~6.8% on mixed holdout
end2end short-prompt p95 -31%
```

jena: 6.8% patch_rate seems high. what about quality deltas?

ravi: 500-sample stratified holdout: EM-style drop 0.9%, embed-cosine mean delta -0.010. human pairwise (200 pairs across extract/summarize/chat): hybrid preferred 24%, baseline 58%, ties 18%. extraction tasks and code token boundaries worst.

kai: any mitigation experiments?

ravi: tried: (1) logit-interp alpha=0.2 (favor main logits) reduced patch_rate to 3.1% but also slightly increased latency due to merge cost; (2) confidence-cascade tightened (prefill only top1>0.75) patch_rate 1.8% but TTFB wins drop ~20%; (3) token-class whitelist (only permit whitespace/stopwords) good quality but minimal speedup.

jena: did you check interactions with kv-cache / incremental decoding? could speculative tokens pollute cache?

ravi: yes 00we kept prefills in ephemeral store and only write to KV on confirmation. runtime note: need atomic swap so clients see final patch events. also saw a corner where main model used the provisional token as context before confirmation in streaming pipeline 00100-> added a provisional flag to stream to prevent that.

kai: cost implications? running both in parallel + merge overhead?

ravi: cost model: for short sessions (median output < 40 tokens) net token cost ~-10% because main model often doesn't need to compute all tokens; for long sessions cost neutral or +. engineering recommendation: route-gating: enable only for routes with median length < 45 and latency SLO strict.

jena: telemetry & rollback hooks?

ravi: must ship: prefills_attempted, prefills_streamed, prefills_confirmed, patch_rate, regen_rate, token_symkl_p95, route_level_pref_success. Auto-disable rule: if patch_rate>5% and route_pref_drop>4% for 6h -> rollback. also prod canary: 0.5% traffic for 12h then ramp.

kai: eval plan?

ravi: proposed:
1) 6k stratified holdout with 1k adversarial token-split cases (company names, hyphens, URLs, camelCase).
2) run 4 variants: alpha=0.0 (no interp), alpha=0.2, tight-conf (only top1>0.75), token-whitelist.
3) metrics: EM/ROUGE/BLEU, embed sim, human N=800 across priority tasks, patch_rate, regen_rate, latency p50/p95, cost/session.
4) include a small adaptive failure taxonomy report and top 50 examples for postmortem.

jena: can you drop the harness + config? I'll start expanded runs.

ravi: harness: 
```
python -m evals.hybrid_prefill --cfg configs/hybrid/alpha02.yaml --samples 5000 --out results/hybrid_alpha02.json
```

ux-bot: note: clients need to render provisional tokens in a lighter UI style and show an edit/patch indicator. product follow-up required.

ravi: thanks. i'll land configs + adversarial set in spec branch and kick off runs. ping here when expanded results land and we'll meet to decide rollout gating. :rocket:
